name: Semerarete ~Gibo~
source:
Main character's mother-in-law triggers a fight with his father and moves into protagonist's place. She treats him like a family, so she does not mind walking in underwear or sleeping together in one bed. But boy sees a young seductive woman in her... Can he control himself alongside her?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的继母与父亲大吵一架后，搬来和他一起住。她把他当作家人，因此不介意只穿内衣走来走去，或与他同睡一张床。但男孩从她身上看见了一个年轻、诱人的女人……和她朝夕相处，他能控制住自己吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
